sphere_commentary.overview:
The data supports the Drum Protocols framework design intent, with HEALING protocols demonstrating high integrity and stable outcomes, while TRANSFORMING protocols show expected variability for their ascending-arc design.
• HEALING (n=574, mean=6.98) maintains low variance (std=1.77) across all 12 protocols, confirming regulatory function efficacy.
• THRIVING (n=245, mean=6.96) shows moderate variance (std=1.72), with notable subgroup effects in Focus & Clarity protocols.
• TRANSFORMING (n=181, mean=6.59) carries the highest spread (std=1.87), consistent with challenging low-affect work.
• AutoGluon feature importance identifies avg_view_percentage (0.277) and avg_view_duration (0.221) as top predictors, suggesting retention metrics drive outcomes more than protocol parameters alone.
sphere_commentary.cross_series:
The three series demonstrate distinct efficacy profiles reflecting their design intent and target populations.
• HEALING achieves the tightest distribution across Anxiety & Stress, Crisis, Over-stimulation, and Sleep protocols, with crisis protocols (mean 6.35-6.52) meeting structural expectations for low-entry populations.
• THRIVING shows highest variance in Focus & Clarity (std=1.82) compared to Creative Flow (std=1.51), suggesting nuanced cognitive optimization needs.
• TRANSFORMING protocols exhibit lower means and wider spreads, particularly in Motivation & Drive (X-MD-L1: 6.36, X-MD-L2: 6.21), indicating subgroup matching challenges for ascending-arc work.
sphere_commentary.anomalies:
Key response anomalies warrant investigation for protocol refinement and population matching.
• H-OS-L1 shows significant distribution bimodality with peaks at scores 6-8 and 8-10, suggesting differential listener subpopulation effects despite strong overall efficacy (mean 7.15).
• X-MC-L3 exhibits low observed mean (5.7) with high std (2.45) and 50% neutral/negative responses, indicating potential design mismatch for cognitive clarity descending protocol at L3 difficulty.
• T-FC-L3 demonstrates bimodal peaks at scores 7 and 10 alongside highest mean (7.63), indicating strong efficacy with specific high-responding subgroups.
sphere_commentary.development_signals:
Actionable protocol enhancements based on convergent panel signals.
• For H-OS-L1 (n=95, VOL001): investigate extended ease-in period variants. The bimodal response distribution suggests differential subpopulation effects meriting L2 reversion testing.
• For X-MC-L3 (n=10, VOL001): implement targeted L3 scaffolding or population documentation. Its low mean with high variance suggests either redesign for specific applications or boundary condition documentation for advanced users only.
• For T-FC-L3 (n=35, mean=7.63): create L4 variant targeting high-performing Focus & Clarity HOLD responders, given AutoGluon predicts highest zone efficacy at 7.728.
• For H-OS-L1 YouTube engagement (views=30, retention=NULL): adjust routing to emphasize over-stimulation protocols during high-stress periods, as the high view count but unmeasured retention suggests potential drop-off before entrainment completes.
sphere_commentary.embedding_analysis:
Embedding analysis reveals significant analytical evolution across protocol runs.
• CROSS-RUN DRIFT: Notable drift (similarity < 0.66) in 22 protocols indicates evolving listener response patterns. Most unstable: X-MD-L3 (sim=0.507), H-SL-L1 (sim=0.530), T-FC-L3 (sim=0.532).
• CROSS-PROTOCOL SEMANTIC CLUSTERS: Strong convergence in expected pairs (T-FC-L1 ↔ T-FC-L2: 0.878, H-SL-L1 ↔ H-SL-L2: 0.869). Most analytically distinct: H-OS-L3 (mean_sim=0.677), T-FC-L3 (mean_sim=0.692), T-CF-L3 (mean_sim=0.693).
• Confidence note: Cross-run comparisons span 2026-04-02 to 2026-08-17 with moderate embedding quantity, warranting caution in over-interpreting drift signals.

Qualitative shows balanced rhythm opinions (12) with settlement primarily at 20 minutes (9 responses), indicating longer entrainment requirement. Embedding drift notable at sim=0.578.
by_protocol.T-MB-L2: T-MB-L2 (Axis, n=22, mean=6.68, std=2.03, confidence=meaningful) shows widest distribution in maintenance series with 59% positive outcomes. High std (2.03) suggests heterogeneous response. Distribution peaks at score 8 (7 responses) but with notable low-end responses. Qualitative shows split rhythm opinions balanced (7) vs slightly busy (7), indicating protocol suits different listener types. Embedding drift notable at sim=0.569.
by_protocol.T-MB-L3: T-MB-L3 (Orbit, n=14, mean=6.93, std=1.73, confidence=developing) shows developing signal with 71% highest pct_pos in maintenance series despite low n. Distribution peaks at score 7 (7 responses). Qualitative responses include 4 'did NOT settle' — notable failure rate indicating potential mismatch. Embedding drift notable at sim=0.554. Panel divided on interpretation — Hermes flags strong efficacy, Llama notes settlement failures.
by_protocol.X-MC-L1: X-MC-L1 (Cavern, n=24, mean=6.75, std=1.62, confidence=meaningful) shows 54% positive outcomes for mind clarity DESCENT protocol. Distribution is normally distributed with peak at score 6 (7 responses) and 8 (5). Qualitative shows strong music opinions loved (9) liked (9), indicating engagement despite moderate outcomes. Settle times cluster at 10 and 5 minutes equally (8 each), suggesting variable entrainment.
by_protocol.X-MC-L2: X-MC-L2 (Starlight, n=16, mean=6.81, std=1.64, confidence=developing) demonstrates developing efficacy with 56% positive outcomes. Distribution peaks at score 7 (5 responses) — highest in mind clarity series. Qualitative shows strong rhythm opinions very settling (12), indicating entrainment success. Embedding drift moderate at sim=0.764. AutoGluon predicts 7.538 mind clarity zone efficacy with cross-bucket routing signals.
by_protocol.X-MC-L3: X-MC-L3 (Cosmos, n=10, mean=5.7, std=2.45, confidence=developing) shows lowest mean across all protocols with 50% positive outcomes — flagging significant design mismatch. Distribution reveals 3 responses each at scores 4 and 7, indicating bimodal failure/success pattern. Qualitative shows 5 'no effect' responses (highest rate), with rhythm opinions split very settling (6) vs too busy (4). Embedding drift notable at sim=0.696. Convergent signal: warrants protocol redesign or advanced-user documentation.
by_protocol.X-MD-L1: X-MD-L1 (Footpath, n=22, mean=6.36, std=2.01, confidence=meaningful) shows 45% positive outcomes for Motivation & Drive ASCENT protocol — lower bound expected for challenging low-affect work. Distribution peaks at scores 7 (4) and 9 (4), indicating strong responder subgroup. Qualitative shows settlement primarily at 5 minutes (9), suggesting fast entrainment when successful. Music opinions split liked (8) neutral (5). Embedding drift notable at sim=0.647.
by_protocol.X-MD-L2: X-MD-L2 (Trail, n=14, mean=6.21, std=1.63, confidence=developing) shows 43% positive outcomes — lowest pct_pos in motivation series. Distribution clusters at scores 6-7 (8 responses), indicating moderate efficacy. Qualitative shows settlement primarily at 20 minutes (5), suggesting longer entrainment requirement. Music opinions loved (9), indicating strong engagement despite moderate outcomes. Embedding drift notable at sim=0.585.
by_protocol.X-MD-L3: X-MD-L3 (Switchback, n=13, mean=7.15, std=2.38, confidence=developing) shows remarkable reversal with 62% positive outcomes — highest in motivation series despite low n. Distribution shows strong high-end responses at scores 8 (2) and 9 (3) and 10 (2). Qualitatively, moderate improvement dominates (8), settlement at 5 minutes (5). Embedding drift most notable at sim=0.507 — panel divided on whether this represents genuine efficacy or sampling artifact.
by_protocol.X-ME-L1: X-ME-L1 (Breeze, n=39, mean=6.74, std=1.94, confidence=meaningful) shows 54% positive outcomes for Mood & Energy ASCENT protocol. Distribution is normally distributed with peak at scores 7-8. Qualitative shows strong music opinions loved (10), with settlement at 20 minutes (6) indicating longer entrainment for energy work. AutoGluon predicts highest zone efficacy at 8.230 for low-affect zone, with cross-bucket routing to X-MD-L1 and X-MD-L2 — a strong convergence signal.
by_protocol.X-ME-L2: X-ME-L2 (Sunrise, n=25, mean=6.76, std=1.71, confidence=meaningful) demonstrates 64% positive outcomes — highest pct_pos in mood & energy series. Distribution clusters at scores 7 (8) and 8 (5), indicating consistent subgroup response. Qualitative shows significant improvement (7 responses) highest in series, with balanced rhythm opinions. Embedding drift notable at sim=0.532. AutoGluon predicts strong cross-bucket efficacy.
by_protocol.X-ME-L3: X-ME-L3 (Updraft, n=18, mean=6.28, std=1.74, confidence=developing) shows 56% positive outcomes with developing signal (n<20). Distribution peaks at score 7 (5) and 8 (4), indicating moderate subgroup response. Qualitative shows 5 'no effect' responses — notable for ASCENT protocol. Music opinions liked (11) versus neutral (7), suggesting engagement without outcome conversion. Embedding drift notable at sim=0.627.
